title: The twelve-sign factorisation
teaches: Z/12 = Z/3 x Z/4 is derived; which factor is modality and which is element follows from their counts, and those counts come from the astrological frame, not from the geometry

asserts.statement: Z/12 = Z/3 x Z/4, so 3 modalities x 4 elements covers twelve cells with no repeat and no gap.
asserts.derivation: gcd(3,4)=1, Chinese Remainder Theorem. This is why there are twelve, not an observation that there happen to be.

asserts.statement: The corpus's three rotation classes are the order of each mark's rotational symmetry group: infinite, 2, 1.
asserts.derivation: Sampled each mark as a point set and rotated it; 6/6 agreement with the stated trichotomy. A sine is odd, so a half-turn returns it -- which is why Wave groups with Line.

carries_undetermined.statement: up+unbarred is Fire, up+barred is Air, down+unbarred is Water, down+barred is Earth.
carries_undetermined.derivation: THE DIRECTION BIT IS DENSITY. F19 records, and F70 confirms on a second artifact, that the elements ARE the states of matter: Fire = Plasma, Air = Gas, Water = Liquid, Earth = Solid. Split the four phases by density and plasma and gas are the rarefied pair, liquid and solid the dense pair; buoyancy lifts the first and sinks the second. That is the direction bit, four for four, one property throughout -- not 'fire rises' about one element but a single threshold on a single quantity sorting all four. And it derives exactly the half that needed deriving: the PARTITION, not which side of the page each lands on, which `direction-is-read-as-contrast` says the notation never reads anyway.
carries_undetermined.given: the states-of-matter identification (F19/F70), and ordinary conditions, under which the density ordering of the four phases holds.
carries_undetermined.success_condition: THE DIRECTION BIT IS REACHED (F148). What remains is the CROSSBAR bit, which partitions {Air, Earth} against {Fire, Water} -- in phases, {Gas, Solid} against {Plasma, Liquid}. F140 gave the bit a reading, open end versus bounded level, which the corpus itself names Destiny and Reality. What is missing is a property of the four phases that groups gas with solid against plasma with liquid. Density does not: solid and gas are the extremes of that ordering, not a pair. A pattern that fits and is NOT evidence: along the transition chain Solid-Liquid-Gas-Plasma the bit is the parity of the position, with positions 1 and 3 barred. With four items and two bits any assignment can be so described, and parity names no physical property. Recorded as F47 recorded the opponent-colour coincidence.
carries_undetermined.scope: The direction bit only. The crossbar bit has a reading (F140) and no derivation. And the derivation runs through a physical identification, so it grounds the notation in matter rather than in geometry -- which is what the original success condition warned about, met by making the import explicit and total rather than anecdotal.

conventional.statement: Fire red, Air yellow, Water blue, Earth green.
conventional.why_not_derivable: A received Golden Dawn convention, adopted wholesale. The observation that the two opponent-colour axes fall on the two 'both bits differ' diagonals has p = 1/3 by chance and is recorded as not evidence.
